prerequisites: Basic engineering knowledge from Technical Mechanics, Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer Science, Machine Elements.
Course Product Development (FZT/MEC) or Design Theory 1 (MAB)

learning_outcomes.text: Students learn to independently and holistically process an innovative task from a scientific, technical or constructive environment in a working group.
Students learn to prepare the results in a technical-scientific documentation and present them to a professional audience with a final presentation.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of the task, specifying requirements in consultation with the supervisor.
Time and, if applicable, cost planning for all relevant project contents, defining suitable milestones.
Systematic and timely processing of all necessary work packages using technically appropriate methods.
Preparation and presentation of interim results to the supervisor upon reaching milestones, and logging of important project-related decisions.
Elaboration of a written technical-scientific documentation of the work results, presentation and defense of the project contents and results to a professional audience.

assessment_methods.method: Oral examination (20 min) following the presentation
